description: This file contains the main activity class for a Wi-Fi Direct (P2P) service discovery and connection application. It manages service registration, discovery, connection setup, and initiates chat sessions over Wi-Fi P2P. The class integrates with Android's Wi-Fi P2P APIs, handles permission requests, manages lifecycle events, and coordinates UI fragments for displaying services and chat messages.

classes.name: WiFiServiceDiscoveryActivity
classes.description: Main activity class managing Wi-Fi Direct service discovery, connections, and chat session management.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, checks for Wi-Fi Direct support, requests permissions, and starts service registration and discovery.

methods.name: initP2p
methods.description: Checks device hardware and software support for Wi-Fi P2P and initializes the manager and channel.

methods.name: startRegistrationAndDiscovery
methods.description: Registers a local Wi-Fi P2P service and begins discovering other services.

methods.name: discoverService
methods.description: Sets DNS-SD response listeners and initiates service discovery.

methods.name: connectP2p
methods.description: Connects to a selected Wi-Fi P2P service.

methods.name: handleMessage
methods.description: Processes incoming messages for reading chat messages and setting chat manager.

methods.name: onConnectionInfoAvailable
methods.description: Handles Wi-Fi P2P connection info, sets up socket handlers, and manages chat fragment instantiation.

methods.name: appendStatus
methods.description: Appends a status message to the UI status text view.
